modeClassicDesc: Travel through 120 curated culinary stages across 6 continents.
modeTimeAttackDesc: Race the clock! Match as many global dishes as possible in 60s.
modeFoodMemoryDesc: Flip & pair matching dishes and countries from hidden cards.
modeEndlessDesc: Rapid incoming dishes on the belt. Survive as long as you can!
resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset all game progress?
ytMutedNotice: Audio is muted by YouTube or device. Unmute YouTube player to hear sound.
howToPlay1: Drag a food dish to its country plate, or tap the dish then tap the country.
howToPlay2: Chain consecutive correct matches to trigger high-scoring Combo multipliers!
howToPlay3: Discover over 160 genuine world foods to complete your encyclopedia.
tutorialPrompt: Drag this dish to the correct country!
tapTutorialPrompt: Or tap dish, then tap country!
passportSubtitle: Explore world cuisines & collect authentic country stamps
stampUnlockedDesc: You have mastered {country} by discovering its iconic dishes!
lockedCountryHint: Match more dishes from this country in gameplay to earn its stamp!
speedChallengeSubtitle: Match as many global dishes as possible before time runs out!
championDescription: You conquered all dishes across 6 continents and earned the Grand World Food Master title!
